located_point.method: Not located beyond the published point. Biagi and Vidale 2022 (held in the plan library directory, infra/plans/lakhanjo-daro/vidale2022) give Mound D, Trench C at 27°43'44" N 68°50'55" E inside the Sukkur industrial area; the 1.5 km Sentinel-2 render shows only industrial buildings, roads and plots there.

imagery_unmeasurable_reason: The site lies inside the Sukkur industrial area; no mound or straight Harappan feature is resolvable at 10 m.

sources.rights_notice: Copernicus Sentinel data terms; Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2018–2026

notes: The held article (Biagi and Vidale 2022, Asian Perspectives 61(1)) contains a location map on a commercial base map (Fig. 3, Google Earth with Maxar imagery) and trench photographs, but no plan of architecture; we did not use the commercial base map. The article cites a published map of the mounds (Shaikh et al. 2004-2005, fig. 4) that we could not obtain as an open scan.
unmeasurable_reason: No plan of architecture found, and no Harappan feature resolvable at 10 m in the imagery (industrial area).
